fusions.name: Raw Keystone
fusions.desc: Hurls a keystone charged with raw mana that deals 30 damage, ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Humming Joints
fusions.desc: Sets the mortar joints around you humming, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Relaid Foundations
fusions.desc: Resets the cooldown of 1 of your other abilities.

fusions.name: Mana-Steeped Mortar
fusions.desc: Your abilities' cooldowns are 8% shorter, and you have 8% arcane resistance.
